express.title: Express Test
express.description: 24 scenario questions in a couple of minutes — a quick snapshot of the Light and Dark triads of your personality as a hexagram.
express.privacyNote: Express is a guest mode: your result is stored only in this browser and is not sent anywhere. It is a self-discovery tool, not a diagnosis or a substitute for professional consultation. To keep the result in an account, link it on the results screen.
express.resultsSubtitle: The overlay of the Light and Dark triads. The full 22-scale portrait is in the complete test.
express.fullTestDescription: Express covers 8 scales. The full test has 22 scales, a cumulative profile, and dynamics. Point your camera at the QR code or open it on this device.
express.linkHint: Your answers are sent to the server, not the scores — the profile is recomputed. XP and achievements are awarded only for account-confirmed runs.
express.linkError: Failed to save the result. Please try again later.
express.shareText: I took the express archetype test — here's my hexagram of the Light and Dark triads. Check yourself:

icebreaker.title: Two questions before you start
icebreaker.q2: Only ~17% of people reach midlife having never met the criteria for a mental disorder — yet almost everyone answers "yes". How come?
icebreaker.source: Dunedin longitudinal cohort: Schaefer et al., 2017, Journal of Abnormal Psychology

quiz.title: Personality Type
quiz.description: Take a 50-question scenario test and discover your personality profile. Each question offers 4 reaction options — choose the one closest to you.
quiz.shareText: I took the archetype test and discovered my 22-scale personality profile. Check yourself:
quiz.submitError: Failed to save results to server. Showing preliminary results.
quiz.noQuestionsHint: The administrator hasn't added questions to the database yet. Please try again later.
quiz.disclaimer: This test is for entertainment purposes only and is not a clinical diagnosis.

guestBanner.title: Save your profile
guestBanner.description: Personality isn't a photograph — it's a film. Mood, stress, and life circumstances shape your answers. Take the test periodically and watch how your profile evolves over time. Each new batch of questions improves accuracy, and registration preserves the entire journey.
guestBanner.benefit1: Cumulative profile — more precise with each session
guestBanner.benefit2: Change history — track your mood dynamics
guestBanner.benefit4: Precise normalization — server-side recalculation across all answers

whyRetake.title: Why take it again?
whyRetake.description: Your answers reflect your current mood and life situation, not a fixed character. Take the test periodically — an averaged profile across multiple sessions will show a more accurate picture of your personality.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.name: Participant
leaderboard.empty: No one has taken the quiz yet

cabinet.title: Psychologist Cabinet
cabinet.becomePsychologistDesc: If you are a psychologist, psychotherapist, or psychiatrist, you can open a professional cabinet. Your clients can link you by email, and you'll see their results with clinical names and dynamics.
cabinet.noClientsHint: Ask your client to link you by email in their profile settings.
cabinet.displayNameHint: Set a convenient name for the client (visible only to you)
cabinet.deleteNoteConfirm: Delete this note? This action cannot be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.myPsychologistDesc: Link a psychologist by email — they will be able to see your quiz results with clinical names and dynamics. You can revoke access at any time.
settings.revokeConfirm: Revoke access for {name}? The psychologist will no longer be able to see your results.
settings.whatSees: The psychologist will see: your personality profile, session dynamics, clinical scale names. They will NOT see: your individual question answers.
settings.myDataDesc: You can delete all your test results at any time — all completed sessions and answers will be removed. This action is irreversible.
settings.deleteDataConfirm: All your sessions and answers will be permanently deleted. Achievements and rank may reset. Continue?
settings.deleteDataError: Failed to delete data. Please try again later.
